theme: EA composite DTM DSM coverage vintage and surface controls
verified_controls: 1m composite DTM covers approximately 99 percent of England
DTM removes surface objects from DSM
newest best-resolution survey is preferred where repeats exist
bilinear interpolation is used where data was resampled
vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
survey-index metadata is required for local vintage identification
WCS access is published for 1m DTM
1m composite DSM also covers approximately 99 percent of England
DSM includes buildings vegetation and vehicles
DTM DSM disagreement is a surface-object contamination guard
2m composite is available as a resolution cross-check
composite vintage must be checked for terrain-change-sensitive parcels
coverage gaps remain NO_DATA rather than interpolated parcel truth
parcel elevation sampling remains blocked until revision14 runtime binds geometry and raster
